Pakistan Turf Club Rules 1962
Pakistan Turf Club Rules 1962
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, 7th May 1962]
S. R. O. 19 (R). In exercise of the powers conferred by section 4
of the Sports (Development and Control) Ordinance, 1962 (XVI of 1962), the
Central Government is pleased to make the following rules for determining the
constitution, powers and functions of the Pakistan Turf Club, being a Board
constituted under section 3 of the said Ordinance:
1. Short
title and commencement. (1) These rules may be called the Pakistan Turf Club Rules,
1962.
(2) They shall come into force at
once.
2. Definitions. In these rules,
unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,
(a) "Chairman" means
the Chairman of the Chub;
(b) "the
Club" means the Pakistan Turf Club constituted under section 3 of the
Sports (Development and Control) Ordinance, 1962 (XVI of 1962);
(c) "local
clubs" means a racing organisation controlling
the running of races in any part of Pakistan
and recognised as such by the Club;
(d) "Member" means a
member of the Club;
(e) "racing"
means horse-racing;
(f) "the rules of
racing" mean the rules to govern
racing through-out Pakistan framed by the Club and duly published under its
authority, and until such rules are published by the Club, the rules laid down by
the Jockey Club of Pakistan and in force immediately before the commencement of
these rules;
(g) "Stewards" means the Stewards of the Club.
3. Term of office of Members,
etc. (1) A
member shall, unless sooner removed by the Central Government, hold office
for a term of five years and shall be eligible for re-appointment.
(2) A casual vacancy in the
office of a member shall ba filled by appointment by
the Central Government, and the member appointed to fill the vacancy shall hold
office for the unexpired period of the term of his predecessor.
4. Jurisdiction. The Club shall be
the supreme controlling authority of all racing in Pakistan and the Stewards
shall be the sole and final arbiters and their decision on any irregularities
noticed or brought to their notice and on other cognate matters relating to
racing shall be final.
5. Headquarters. The Club shall
have its headquarters at such place at it may determine.
6. Functions of the Club.-- The following shall be the functions of the Club, namely :
(i) To
promote, encourage, support, facilitate, organise and
control racing all over Pakistan;
(ii) To appoint and determine the scales of
pay and conditions of service of the staff of the Club ;
(iii) To frame and publish rules
of racing, regulating the running of races at all race meetings held under the
sanction of the Club, and to the conduct of such meetings ;
(iv) To supervise and control the
conduct of race meetings throughout Pakistan ;
(v) To recognise
local clubs and to withdraw its recognition from any such club
;
(vi) To sanction the running of
races at all race meetings through-out Pakistan ;
(vii) To allocate dates and
periods of racing fixtures to various local clubs ;
(viii) To frame rules,
regulations and bye-laws of the Club ;
(ix) To approve the budget of the
Club ;
(x) To frame rules regulating the
expending of its funds ;
(xi) To raise moneys for the Club
by levying such fees under its rules as may
be considered necessary from time to time to be used for its purposes by
or under the authority of the Stewards
(xii) To obtain such movable or
immovable properties as may be required for the purposes of the Club, and to
maintain, manage, improve, alter, supplement or dispose of or deal with the
same or any part thereof or any interest therein, temporarily or otherwise, as
may be necessary in the interest of the Club ;
(xiii) To publish such
periodicals, reports, books and other publica tions as may be warranted by the
objects of the Club, from time to time, including the Pakistani Stud-Book,
Stallions Register, Rules of Racing, Results of Races held under the rules of
